title: Review speed's design review names a "read-only Codex explorer" with no stand-in for an unavailable vendor; align it with the stand-in reviewer rule
outcome: Review speed's design review names a "read-only Codex explorer" with no stand-in for an unavailable vendor; align it with the stand-in reviewer rule
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (byte-identical) and .claude/commands/review-changes.md name the design-review explorer as a read-only Codex explorer with a stand-in of another vendor when Codex is unavailable (usage limit or outage met at that time, recorded on the item), worded consistently with the stand-in reviewer rule landed by the standing-approval amendment

Both coordinators' concurrence on the exact wording and Greg's disclosure are recorded on this item before landing, as the authority-text rule requires; the link check and the AGENTS/CLAUDE identity check pass through the focused launcher on the frozen tree

completion.summary: Kimi now stands in only when Codex is unavailable. The changes cover the standing approval, the Review Cadence rules, the /review-changes command and the workflow docs. They also add a read-only Kimi explorer as a stand-in for design review, the limits of one stand-in per round and at most two reviews that count, the fewer-than-two rule, a stop-list clause scoped to the two required reviews, and the optional third Kimi review (its own title and fan-in; it never counts or blocks). Landed as ff305a6 on origin/master; docs only, so no build was installed.
